title: Cell-7 Heading Before Unrelated Columns

illustrates.quote: Maintaining the hierarchy of headings in a document is important, and there may be times when columned material will follow a cell-7 heading. Insert a blank line to separate the cell-7 heading from the columns, so it is clear the heading is related to all columns.

blocks.features: Plain four-column word list, no column headers; the four columns are unrelated to one another (each is a separate alphabetized block), so the braille joins them only with plain spaces, not guide dots -- unlike Example 4-10's related columns. Recorded as `other` for the same reason as Example 4-10's table: no table/columns block type in this print.blocks model.

print.notes: Illustrates a blank line inserted between a cell-7 heading and the four-column word list that follows it, per rule 4.6.5. Note the source example's own title says 'Unrelated Columns' even though the governing rule (4.6.5) concerns columns related to the heading; quoted verbatim, not corrected.
print.printFeatures: Bold left-aligned heading above an unheaded four-column word list.

braille.notes: Line 1 blank; line 2 the cell-7 heading 'Verbs'; line 3 blank, per 4.6.5; lines 4-7 the four-column word list, columns separated only by plain spaces (unrelated columns, no guide dots); line 8 blank.

uncertain: The four-column word list has no table/columns block type in this print.blocks model and is recorded as `other`; expect a documented mismatch on the list rows, not the heading.
resolution: braille.lines agree; `kind` resolved to `other` for the same reason as Example 4-10 (no related/unrelated-columns block type available). Heading level 3 (cell-7) confirmed directly by the 6-cell indent.
